content.shloka:
Vakratunda Mahaakaaya Suryakoti Samaprabha
Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarva Kaaryeshu Sarvadaa
content.meaning: O Lord with a curved trunk, large body, and the brilliance of a million suns, please remove all obstacles from my endeavors, always.
content.transliteration:
Vakratuṇḍa Mahākāya Sūryakoṭi Samaprabha
Nirvighnaṃ Kuru Me Deva Sarva Kāryeṣu Sarvadā

content.shloka:
Agajaanana Padmaarkam Gajaananam Aharnisham
Anekadantam Bhaktaanaam Ekadantam Upaasmahe
content.meaning: We meditate upon the one-tusked Lord, who is the lotus-like son of Goddess Parvati, who has an elephant face, and who is worshipped by devotees day and night.
content.transliteration:
Agajānana Padmārkaṃ Gajānanaṃ Aharnisham
Anekadantaṃ Bhaktānāṃ Ekadantaṃ Upāsmahe

content.shloka:
Gajaananam Bhootaganaadisevitam
Kapittha Jamboo Phalasaara Bhakshitam
Umaasutam Shokavanaashakaaranam
Namaami Vighneshvara Paadapankajam
content.meaning: I bow to the lotus feet of Vighneshvara, the elephant-faced one, served by the host of beings, who eats the essence of kapittha and jambu fruits, the son of Uma, the destroyer of sorrows.
content.transliteration:
Gajānanaṃ Bhūtagaṇādisevitaṃ
Kapittha Jambū Phalasāra Bhakṣitaṃ
Umāsutaṃ Śokavanāśakāraṇaṃ
Namāmi Vighneśvara Pādapaṅkajam

content.shloka:
Pranamya Shirasa Devam Gauriputram Vinaayakam
Bhaktaavaasam Smare Nityam Aayuh Kaamaarthasiddhaye
content.meaning: Bowing my head to Lord Vinayaka, the son of Gauri, I remember Him daily, who dwells in the hearts of devotees, for the fulfillment of longevity, desires, and prosperity.
content.transliteration:
Praṇamya Śirasā Devaṃ Gaurīputraṃ Vināyakam
Bhaktāvāsaṃ Smare Nityaṃ Āyuḥ Kāmārthasiddhaye

content.shloka:
Ekadantam Mahaakaayam Taptakaanchana Sannibham
Lambodaram Vishaalaaksham Vandeham Ganapatimsadaa
content.meaning: I forever salute Ganapati, the one-tusked, great-bodied one, shining like molten gold, with a large belly and broad eyes.
content.transliteration:
Ekadantaṃ Mahākāyaṃ Taptakāñcana Sannibham
Lambodaraṃ Viśālākṣaṃ Vandehaṃ Gaṇapatiṃ Sadā

content.shloka:
Prabhum Praananatham Vibhum Vishvanatham
Jagannatha Natham Sadaananda Bhaajam
Bhavadbhavya Bhooteshvaram Bhootanatham
Shivam Shankaram Shambhu Meeshaanamide
content.meaning: I praise Shiva, the Lord of all, the master of life-breath, the all-pervading Lord of the universe, the Lord of the world, ever blissful, the Lord of all beings past and future, Shankara, Shambhu, the supreme ruler.
content.transliteration:
Prabhuṃ Prāṇanāthaṃ Vibhuṃ Viśvanāthaṃ
Jagannātha Nāthaṃ Sadānanda Bhājam
Bhavadbhavya Bhūteśvaraṃ Bhūtanāthaṃ
Śivaṃ Śaṅkaraṃ Śambhu Mīśānamīḍe

content.shloka:
Vande Deva Umaapatim Suraguru Vande Jagatkaaranam
Vande Pannaga Bhooshanam Mrigadharam Vande Pashoonaam Patim
Vande Soorya Shashanka Vahni Nayanam Vande Mukundapriyam
Vande Bhakta Janaashrayam Cha Varadam Vande Shivam Shankaram
content.meaning: I salute the Lord, consort of Uma, the guru of gods, the cause of the world. I salute the one adorned with serpents, who holds a deer, the Lord of creatures. I salute the one whose eyes are the sun, moon, and fire, dear to Mukunda. I salute the refuge of devotees, the bestower of boons, Shiva Shankara.
content.transliteration:
Vande Deva Umāpatiṃ Suraguruṃ Vande Jagatkāraṇaṃ
Vande Pannaga Bhūṣaṇaṃ Mṛgadharaṃ Vande Paśūnāṃ Patim
Vande Sūrya Śaśāṅka Vahni Nayanaṃ Vande Mukundapriyaṃ
Vande Bhakta Janāśrayaṃ Ca Varadaṃ Vande Śivaṃ Śaṅkaram

content.shloka:
Namo Bhootanatham Namo Devadevm
Namo Kaala Kaalam Namo Divyatejaah
Namo Kaamakaalam Namo Shoolapaanim
Namasthe Namaste Namaste Namaste
content.meaning: Salutations to the Lord of beings, salutations to the God of gods. Salutations to the destroyer of time, salutations to the one of divine radiance. Salutations to the one who transcends desire and time, to the wielder of the trident. Salutations to You, again and again.
content.transliteration:
Namo Bhūtanāthaṃ Namo Devadevaṃ
Namo Kāla Kālaṃ Namo Divyatejāḥ
Namo Kāmakālaṃ Namo Śūlapāṇim
Namaste Namaste Namaste Namaste

content.shloka:
Karpoora Gauram Karunaa Avataaram
Samsaara Saaram Bhujagendra Haaram
Sadaa Vasantam Hridayaaravinde
Bhavam Bhavaanee Sahitam Namaami
content.meaning: I bow to the one who is white as camphor, the incarnation of compassion, the essence of worldly existence, who wears the king of serpents as a garland, who always dwells in the lotus of the heart, along with Goddess Bhavani.
content.transliteration:
Karpūra Gauraṃ Karuṇā Avatāraṃ
Saṃsāra Sāraṃ Bhujagendra Hāraṃ
Sadā Vasantaṃ Hṛdayāravinde
Bhavaṃ Bhavānī Sahitaṃ Namāmi

content.shloka:
Shivaaya Gauri Vadanaabja Vrinda
Suryaaya Dakshadhvara Naashkaaya
Shree Neelakanthaaya Vrisha Dhwajaaya
Tasmai Shi Karaaya Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations to Shiva, who is the sun to the lotus face of Gauri, the destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice, the blue-throated one, whose banner bears the bull. Salutations to that auspicious Shankara.
content.transliteration:
Śivāya Gaurī Vadanābja Vṛnda
Sūryāya Dakṣādhvara Nāśakāya
Śrī Nīlakaṇṭhāya Vṛṣa Dhvajāya
Tasmai Śī Karāya Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Shaantaakaaram Bhujagashayanam Padmanaabham Suresham
Vishvaadhaaram Gaganasadrisham Meghavarnam Shubhaangam
Lakshmikaantam Kamalanayanam Yogibhir Dhyaanagamyam
Vande Vishnum Bhavabhayaharam Sarvalokaika Naatham
content.meaning: I salute Lord Vishnu, who has a peaceful form, who reclines on the serpent, who has a lotus at his navel, the Lord of gods, the support of the universe, vast as the sky, dark as clouds, with beautiful limbs, the beloved of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, attainable through meditation by yogis, the remover of the fear of worldly existence, the sole Lord of all worlds.
content.transliteration:
Śāntākāraṃ Bhujagaśayanaṃ Padmanābhaṃ Sureśaṃ
Viśvādhāraṃ Gaganasadṛśaṃ Meghavarṇaṃ Śubhāṅgam
Lakṣmīkāntaṃ Kamalanayanaṃ Yogibhir Dhyānagamyaṃ
Vande Viṣṇuṃ Bhavabhayaharaṃ Sarvalokaikanaātham

content.shloka:
Megha Shyaamam Peetakausheya Vaasam
Shreevatsa Ankam Kaustubhod Bhaasitaangam
Pundareekayata Chaarunetram
Vishnum Vande Sarva Lokaika Naatham
content.meaning: I salute Vishnu, the Lord of all worlds, who is dark as a cloud, dressed in yellow silk, marked with Shreevatsa, whose body shines with the Kaustubha gem, with beautiful lotus-like eyes.
content.transliteration:
Megha Śyāmaṃ Pītakauśeya Vāsam
Śrīvatsa Aṅkaṃ Kaustubhod Bhāsitāṅgam
Puṇḍarīkāyata Cārunetraṃ
Viṣṇuṃ Vande Sarva Lokaika Nātham

content.shloka:
Namaah Samastaabhootaanaam Aadibhootaaya Bhoobhrite
Aneka Roopa Roopaaya Vishnave Prabha Vishnave
content.meaning: Salutations to Vishnu, the primal being of all creatures, the supporter of the earth, who has innumerable forms, the radiant Vishnu.
content.transliteration:
Namaḥ Samastābhūtānāṃ Ādibhūtāya Bhūbhṛte
Aneka Rūpa Rūpāya Viṣṇave Prabha Viṣṇave

content.shloka:
Tvameva Maataa Cha Pitaa Tvameva
Tvameva Bandhuscha Sakhaa Tvameva
Tvameva Vidyaa Dravinam Tvameva
Tvameva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva
content.meaning: You alone are my mother and father, You alone are my relative and friend, You alone are my knowledge and wealth, You alone are everything to me, O God of gods.
content.transliteration:
Tvameva Mātā Ca Pitā Tvameva
Tvameva Bandhuśca Sakhā Tvameva
Tvameva Vidyā Draviṇaṃ Tvameva
Tvameva Sarvaṃ Mama Deva Deva

content.shloka:
Kayena Vaacha Manasendriyairvaa
Buddhyaatmanaa Vaa Prakriteh Svabhaavaat
Karomi Yadyat Sakalam Parasmai
Naaraayanaayeti Samarpayaami
content.meaning: Whatever I do with my body, speech, mind, senses, intellect, soul, or by the force of nature, I dedicate all of it to Lord Narayana.
content.transliteration:
Kāyena Vācā Manasendriayairvā
Budhyātmanā Vā Prakṛteḥ Svabhāvāt
Karomi Yadyat Sakalaṃ Parasmai
Nārāyaṇāyeti Samarpayāmi

content.shloka:
Sarva Mangala Maangalye Shive Sarvaartha Saadhike
Sharanye Trayambake Gauri Naaraayani Namostute
content.meaning: Salutations to Narayani, the most auspicious one, the consort of Shiva, the fulfiller of all objectives, the refuge of all, the three-eyed Gauri.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Maṅgala Māṅgalye Śive Sarvārtha Sādhike
Śaraṇye Trayāmbake Gauri Nārāyaṇi Namostute

content.shloka:
Yaa Devi Sarvabhooteshu Shakti Roopena Samsthitaa
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations again and again to the Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of power (Shakti).
content.transliteration:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Śakti Rūpeṇa Saṃsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Yaa Devi Sarvabhooteshu Buddhi Roopena Samsthitaa
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations again and again to the Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of intelligence (Buddhi).
content.transliteration:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Buddhi Rūpeṇa Saṃsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Yaa Devi Sarvabhooteshu Kshudha Roopena Samsthitaa
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations again and again to the Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of hunger.
content.transliteration:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Kṣudhā Rūpeṇa Saṃsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Yaa Devi Sarvabhooteshu Lakshmee Roopena Samsthitaa
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations again and again to the Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of Lakshmi (prosperity).
content.transliteration:
Yā Devī Sarvabhūteṣu Lakṣmī Rūpeṇa Saṃsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Srishti Sthiti Vinaashaanaam Shakti Bhoote Sanaatani
Gunashraye Gunmaiye Naaraayani Namostute
content.meaning: Salutations to Narayani, the eternal power behind creation, preservation, and destruction, the abode of the three gunas, who is the embodiment of all gunas.
content.transliteration:
Sṛṣṭi Sthiti Vināśānāṃ Śakti Bhūte Sanātani
Guṇāśraye Guṇamaye Nārāyaṇi Namostute

content.shloka:
Namastestu Mahamaye Shreepithe Sura Poojite
Shankha Chakra Gada Haste Mahalakshmi Namostute
content.meaning: Salutations to You, O Mahamaya, seated on the sacred throne, worshipped by the gods. O Mahalakshmi, who holds the conch, discus, and mace, I bow to You.
content.transliteration:
Namastestu Mahāmāye Śrīpīṭhe Sura Pūjite
Śaṅkha Cakra Gadā Haste Mahālakṣmi Namostute

content.shloka:
Sarvajna Sarva Varade Sarva Dushta Bhayankari
Sarva Duhkha Hare Devi Mahalakshmi Namostute
content.meaning: O all-knowing one, bestower of all boons, terrifying to all the wicked, remover of all sorrows, O Goddess Mahalakshmi, I bow to You.
content.transliteration:
Sarvajña Sarva Varade Sarva Duṣṭa Bhayaṅkari
Sarva Duḥkha Hare Devi Mahālakṣmi Namostute

content.shloka:
Siddhi Buddhi Prade Devi Bhukti Mukti Pradaayini
Mantra Moorte Sadaa Devi Mahalakshmi Namostute
content.meaning: O Goddess who bestows accomplishment and wisdom, who grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, who is the embodiment of sacred mantras, O Mahalakshmi, I bow to You.
content.transliteration:
Siddhi Buddhi Prade Devi Bhukti Mukti Pradāyini
Mantra Mūrte Sadā Devi Mahālakṣmi Namostute

content.shloka:
Padmaasana Sthite Devi Parabrahma Svaroopini
Parameshi Jagan Maatar Mahalakshmi Namostute
content.meaning: O Goddess seated in the lotus posture, who is the form of the Supreme Brahman, the supreme ruler, the mother of the universe, O Mahalakshmi, I bow to You.
content.transliteration:
Padmāsana Sthite Devi Parabrahma Svarūpiṇi
Parameśi Jagan Mātar Mahālakṣmi Namostute

content.shloka:
Shvetaambaradhare Devi Naanaalankaara Bhooshite
Jagatsthite Jagan Maatar Mahalakshmi Namostute
content.meaning: O Goddess clad in white garments, adorned with various ornaments, who pervades the world, the mother of the universe, O Mahalakshmi, I bow to You.
content.transliteration:
Śvetāmbaradhare Devi Nānālaṅkāra Bhūṣite
Jagatsthite Jagan Mātar Mahālakṣmi Namostute

content.shloka:
Yaa Kundendu Tushaara Haaradhavalaa Yaa Shubhravastraavritaa
Yaa Veenaa Varadanda Manditakaraa Yaa Shvetapadmaasanaa
Yaa Brahmaachyuta Shankaraprabhritibhir Devaisadaa Vandita
Saa Maam Paatu Saraswati Bhagavati Nihsheshajaadyaapahaa
content.meaning: May Goddess Saraswati protect me - she who is white as a jasmine flower, the moon, and a garland of snow, who is dressed in pure white garments, whose hands are adorned with the veena and the gesture of blessing, who is seated on a white lotus, who is always worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu, Shankara, and other gods, and who removes all traces of ignorance.
content.transliteration:
Yā Kundendu Tuṣāra Hāradhavalā Yā Śubhravastrāvṛtā
Yā Vīṇā Varadaṇḍa Maṇḍitakarā Yā Śvetapadmāsanā
Yā Brahmācyuta Śaṅkaraprabhṛtibhir Devaisadā Vanditā
Sā Māṃ Pātu Sarasvatī Bhagavatī Niḥśeṣajāḍyāpahā

content.shloka:
Saraswati Namastubhyam Varade Kaamaroopini
Vidyaarambham Karishyaami Siddhirbhavatu Me Sadaa
content.meaning: Salutations to you, O Saraswati, the bestower of boons, the fulfiller of desires. I am beginning my studies; may I always attain success.
content.transliteration:
Sarasvatī Namastubhyaṃ Varade Kāmarūpiṇi
Vidyārambhaṃ Kariṣyāmi Siddhirbhavatu Me Sadā

content.shloka:
Shuklaam Brahmavichaara Saaraparamaam Aadyaam Jagadvyaapineem
Veena Pustaka Dhaarineem Abhayadaam Jaadyaandhakaraapahaam
Haste Sphaatika Maalikaam Vidadhateem Padmaasane Samsthitaam
Vande Taam Parameshwareem Bhagavateem Buddhipradaam Shaaradaam
content.meaning: I salute Goddess Sharada, who is white, who is the supreme essence of Brahma-knowledge, the first, who pervades the universe, who holds the veena and book, who grants fearlessness, who removes the darkness of ignorance, who holds a crystal rosary in her hand, who is seated on a lotus, the supreme Goddess who bestows wisdom.
content.transliteration:
Śuklāṃ Brahmavicāra Sāraparamāṃ Ādyāṃ Jagadvyāpinīṃ
Vīṇā Pustaka Dhāriṇīṃ Abhayadāṃ Jāḍyāndhakārāpahām
Haste Sphāṭika Mālikāṃ Vidadhatīṃ Padmāsane Saṃsthitām
Vande Tāṃ Parameśvarīṃ Bhagavatīṃ Buddhipradāṃ Śāradām

content.shloka:
Padma Patra Vishaalaakshi Padma Kesara Varnini
Nityam Padmaalayaam Devim Saa Maam Paatu Sarasvatim
content.meaning: May Goddess Saraswati, whose eyes are broad like lotus petals, whose complexion is like the filaments of a lotus, who always resides in the lotus, protect me.
content.transliteration:
Padma Patra Viśālākṣi Padma Kesara Varṇini
Nityaṃ Padmālayāṃ Devīṃ Sā Māṃ Pātu Sarasvatīm

content.shloka:
Shree Raamachandra Kripalu Bhaju Mana
Harana Bhavabhaya Daarunam
Navakanja Lochana Kanja Mukha
Kara Kanja Pada Kanjarunam
content.meaning: O my mind, worship the compassionate Lord Ramachandra, who removes the terrible fear of worldly existence. His eyes are like fresh lotuses, his face is lotus-like, his hands and lotus-feet are rosy-red.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Rāmacandra Kṛpālu Bhaju Mana
Haraṇa Bhavabhaya Dāruṇam
Navakañja Locana Kañja Mukha
Kara Kañja Pada Kañjāruṇam

content.shloka:
Kandarpa Aganita Amita Chhabi
Nava Neela Neeraja Sundaram
Patapiita Maanahu Tadita Ruchi
Shuachi Nomi Janakatanayaavaram
content.meaning: His beauty surpasses that of countless Kamadevas, he is beautiful like a fresh blue lotus. His yellow garments shine like lightning. I bow to the blessed groom of Janaka's daughter.
content.transliteration:
Kandarpa Aganita Amita Chabi
Nava Nīla Nīraja Sundaram
Paṭapīta Mānahu Taḍita Ruci
Śuci Nomi Janakatanayāvaram

content.shloka:
Bhaju Deena Bandhu Dinesh Daanava
Daitya Vansha Nikandanam
Raghunanda Aananda Kanda Koshala
Chanda Dasharatha Nandanam
content.meaning: Worship the friend of the meek, the Lord of the day, the destroyer of the demon and daitya clans, Raghunanda, the root of bliss, the delight of Koshala, the son of King Dasharatha.
content.transliteration:
Bhaju Dīna Bandhu Dineśa Dānava
Daitya Vaṃśa Nikaṇḍanam
Raghunanda Ānanda Kanda Kośala
Canda Daśaratha Nandanam

content.shloka:
Sira Mukuta Kundala Tilaka Chaaru
Udaaru Anga Vibhooshanam
Aajaanu Bhuja Shara Chaapa Dhara
Sangrama Jita Kharadooshanam
content.meaning: He has a crown on his head, beautiful earrings, a tilak mark, and splendid ornaments on his noble limbs. His arms reach his knees, he holds arrows and a bow, and he conquered Khara and Dushana in battle.
content.transliteration:
Sira Mukuṭa Kuṇḍala Tilaka Cāru
Udāru Aṅga Vibhūṣaṇam
Ājānu Bhuja Śara Cāpa Dhara
Saṅgrāma Jita Kharadūṣaṇam

content.shloka:
Mana Jaahi Rachho Avguna Chhaadana
Jasu Veda Brajaan Aviraama
Raamaa Rameshu Maheshu Vaani
Sheshu Sahasa Guna Gaavai
content.meaning: O mind, abandon deceit and take refuge in Him whose glory the Vedas ceaselessly sing, whom Rama (Lakshmi), Ramesh (Vishnu), Mahesh (Shiva), Vani (Saraswati), and Shesha praise with thousand attributes.
content.transliteration:
Mana Jāhi Raccho Avaguṇa Chādana
Jasu Veda Brajān Avirāma
Rāmā Rameśu Maheśu Vāṇī
Śeṣu Sahasa Guṇa Gāvai

content.shloka:
Vasudeva Sutam Devam Kamsa Chaanoora Mardanam
Devaki Paramanandam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum
content.meaning: I salute Lord Krishna, the son of Vasudeva, the destroyer of Kamsa and Chanura, the supreme bliss of Devaki, the guru of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Vāsudeva Sutaṃ Devaṃ Kaṃsa Cāṇūra Mardanam
Devakī Paramānandaṃ Kṛṣṇaṃ Vande Jagadgurum

content.shloka:
Krishnaaya Vaasudevaaya Devaki Nandanaaya Cha
Nandagopa Kumaaraaya Govindaaya Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations to Krishna, the son of Vasudeva, the delight of Devaki, the young son of Nandagopa, to Govinda, repeated salutations.
content.transliteration:
Kṛṣṇāya Vāsudevāya Devakī Nandanāya Ca
Nandagopa Kumārāya Govindāya Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Aadhaarambujamadhyagam Nayanayoraadhaaram Aadhou Sthitam
Aalokyam Madhuradrisundara Tanum Gopaanganaaveshtitam
Kundendupratigaatri Dantavalitam Peetaambaraanvitam
Govindam Kalavenum Aashrita Padam Divyam Namaami Shriyam
content.meaning: I salute the divine Govinda, who stands at the center like the base of a lotus, who is the foundation for the eyes, who is beautiful like the mountain of sweetness, surrounded by gopis, whose teeth outshine jasmine and moonlight, who wears yellow garments, who holds the divine flute, and who is the refuge of all.
content.transliteration:
Ādhārambujamadyagaṃ Nayanayoradhāraṃ Ādhou Sthitaṃ
Ālokyaṃ Madhurādrisundara Tanuṃ Gopāṅganāveṣṭitam
Kundendupratigātri Dantavalitaṃ Pītāmbarānvitam
Govindaṃ Kalaveṇuṃ Āśrita Padaṃ Divyaṃ Namāmi Śriyam

content.shloka:
Mandaarakrita Sundaram Parivritam Govardhanoddhaarakam
Gopi Cheta Haramdaram Kucha Kutirm Shreevatsa Chitram Mahah
Shaaradenduvadanaaravindam Ajitam Kamsaaredarpaapaham
Sreekrishnam Smaraami Sadaa Hridikayam Vande Jagadmohanamdyam
content.meaning: I always remember Sri Krishna, beautiful with mandara flowers, who lifted Govardhana, who steals the hearts of the gopis, who bears the Shreevatsa mark, whose lotus face is like the autumn moon, the unconquered one who destroyed the pride of Kamsa, the enchanter of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Mandārakṛta Sundaraṃ Parivṛtaṃ Govardhanodhārakaṃ
Gopī Ceta Haramdaraṃ Kuca Kuṭiraṃ Śrīvatsa Citraṃ Mahaḥ
Śāradenduvadanāravindaṃ Ajitaṃ Kaṃsāredarpāpahaṃ
Śrīkṛṣṇaṃ Smarāmi Sadā Hṛdikayaṃ Vande Jagadmohanam

content.shloka:
Achyutam Keshavam Raamanaaraayanam
Krishna Daamodaram Vaasudevam Harim
Shreedharam Maadhavam Gopikaavallabham
Jaanaki Naayakam Raamachandram Bhaje
content.meaning: I worship Achyuta, Keshava, Rama, Narayana, Krishna, Damodara, Vasudeva, Hari, Shreedhara, Madhava, the beloved of the gopis, the lord of Janaki, Ramachandra.
content.transliteration:
Acyutaṃ Keśavaṃ Rāmanārāyaṇaṃ
Kṛṣṇa Dāmodaraṃ Vāsudevaṃ Harim
Śrīdharaṃ Mādhavaṃ Gopikāvallabhaṃ
Jānakī Nāyakaṃ Rāmacandraṃ Bhaje

content.shloka:
Manojavam Maarutatulya Vegam
Jitendriyam Buddhimataam Varishtham
Vaataatmajam Vaanarayoothmukhyam
Shreeraama Dootam Sharanam Prapadye
content.meaning: I take refuge in Sri Rama's messenger, who is swift as the mind, equal in speed to the wind, master of the senses, foremost among the intelligent, the son of the Wind God, the chief of the monkey army.
content.transliteration:
Manojavaṃ Mārutatulya Vegaṃ
Jitendriyaṃ Buddhimatāṃ Variṣṭham
Vātātmajaṃ Vānarayūthamukhyaṃ
Śrīrāma Dūtaṃ Śaraṇaṃ Prapadye

content.shloka:
Buddhir Balam Yasho Dhairyam Nirbhayatvam Arogata
Ajaadyam Vaak Patutvancha Hanumat Smaranaat Bhavet
content.meaning: By remembering Hanuman, one attains wisdom, strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, good health, freedom from laziness, and eloquence of speech.
content.transliteration:
Buddhir Balaṃ Yaśo Dhairyaṃ Nirbhayatvaṃ Arogatā
Ajāḍyaṃ Vāk Paṭutvanca Hanumat Smaraṇāt Bhavet

content.shloka:
Atulit Bala Dhaamam Hemashailaabha Deham
Danuja Vana Krishaanum Jnaanina Magraganyam
Sakala Guna Nidhaanam Vaanaraanaam Adhisham
Raghupati Priya Bhaktam Vaata Jaatam Namaami
content.meaning: I bow to Hanuman, the son of the wind, who has incomparable strength, whose body shines like a golden mountain, who is a fire to the forest of demons, foremost among the wise, the treasure of all virtues, the king of monkeys, and the beloved devotee of Lord Rama.
content.transliteration:
Atulita Bala Dhāmaṃ Hemaśailābha Dehaṃ
Danuja Vana Kṛśānuṃ Jñānināṃ Agragaṇyam
Sakala Guṇa Nidhānaṃ Vānarāṇāṃ Adhiśam
Raghupati Priya Bhaktaṃ Vāta Jātaṃ Namāmi

content.shloka:
Anjana Nandanam Veeram Jaanaki Shoka Naashanam
Kapeesham Akshahankaaram Vande Lanka Bhayankaram
content.meaning: I salute the heroic son of Anjana, the destroyer of Sita's sorrow, the lord of monkeys, the slayer of Akshakumara, the one who is fearsome to Lanka.
content.transliteration:
Añjanā Nandanaṃ Vīraṃ Jānakī Śoka Nāśanam
Kapīśaṃ Akṣahankāraṃ Vande Laṅkā Bhayaṅkaram

content.shloka:
Ullanghya Sindhoh Salilam Saleelam
Yah Shoka Vahnim Janakaat Majaayaah
Aadaaya Tenaiva Dadaaha Lankaam
Namaami Tam Praanjali Raanjaneeyam
content.meaning: He who effortlessly leaped across the ocean, who extinguished the fire of sorrow of Sita, the daughter of Janaka, and with that very fire set Lanka ablaze - I bow with folded hands to that son of Anjana.
content.transliteration:
Ullaṅghya Sindhoḥ Salilaṃ Salīlaṃ
Yaḥ Śoka Vahniṃ Janakātmajāyāḥ
Ādāya Tenaiva Dadāha Laṅkām
Namāmi Taṃ Prāñjali Rāñjanīyam

content.shloka:
Japaakusuma Sankaasham Kashyapeyam Mahaadyutim
Tamorim Sarva Paapghnam Pranatosmi Divaakaram
content.meaning: I bow to the Sun God, Divakara, who shines like a hibiscus flower, the son of Kashyapa, of great brilliance, the enemy of darkness, the destroyer of all sins.
content.transliteration:
Japākusuma Saṅkāśaṃ Kāśyapeyaṃ Mahādyutim
Tamorim Sarva Pāpaghnaṃ Praṇatosmi Divākaram

content.shloka:
Udayaadri Mani Shreshtham Udayaam Bhaskaram Jagatah
Deepaaya Tasmai Sooryaaya Pranatosmi Divaakaram
content.meaning: I prostrate before the Sun, the supreme jewel rising from the eastern mountain, Bhaskara who illuminates the whole world, the lamp of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Udayādri Maṇi Śreṣṭhaṃ Udayāṃ Bhāskaraṃ Jagataḥ
Dīpāya Tasmai Sūryāya Praṇatosmi Divākaram

content.shloka:
Aadityasya Namaskaaran Ye Kurvanti Dine Dine
Aayuh Prajnaa Balam Veeryam Tejasteshah Cha Jaayate
content.meaning: Those who offer salutations to the Sun daily gain longevity, wisdom, strength, valor, and radiance.
content.transliteration:
Ādityasya Namaskārān Ye Kurvanti Dine Dine
Āyuḥ Prajñā Balaṃ Vīryaṃ Tejasteṣāṃ Ca Jāyate

content.shloka:
Bhaanu Bhaaskara Maartaanda Chanda Rashmi Divaakar
Aayuh Aarogyam Aishwaryam Vidyaam Dehi Divaakara
content.meaning: O Bhanu, Bhaskara, Martanda, fierce-rayed Divakara - grant me longevity, health, prosperity, and knowledge, O Sun God.
content.transliteration:
Bhānu Bhāskara Mārtāṇḍa Caṇḍa Raśmi Divākara
Āyuḥ Ārogyaṃ Aiśvaryaṃ Vidyāṃ Dehi Divākara

content.shloka:
Dhyeyah Sadaa Savitri Mandala Madhyavarti
Naaraayanaah Sarasijaa Sana Sannivishthah
Keyooravaan Makarakundalavaan Kiritee
Haaree Hiranya Mava Vapuh Dhrita Shankha Chakrah
content.meaning: One should always meditate on Lord Narayana who resides in the center of the solar orb, seated on a lotus, wearing armlets, makara-shaped earrings, a crown, a golden garland, with a golden body, holding the conch and discus.
content.transliteration:
Dhyeyaḥ Sadā Savitṛ Maṇḍala Madhyavartī
Nārāyaṇaḥ Sarasijā Sana Sanniviṣṭhaḥ
Keyūravān Makarakuṇḍalavān Kirīṭī
Hārī Hiraṇya Maya Vapuḥ Dhṛta Śaṅkha Cakraḥ

content.shloka:
Na Mantram No Yantram Tadapi Cha Na Jaane Stuti Maho
Na Chaahvaanam Dhyaanam Tadapi Cha Na Jaane Stutikathah
Na Jaane Mudraaste Tadapi Cha Na Jaane Vilapanam
Param Jaane Maatastvad Anusaranam Kleshahranam
content.meaning: I know no mantra, no yantra, nor do I know any hymn of praise. I know not invocation, nor meditation, nor do I know any stories of Your praise. I know no mudras, nor do I know how to cry to You. But this I know, O Mother, that to follow You is to remove all suffering.
content.transliteration:
Na Mantraṃ No Yantraṃ Tadapi Ca Na Jāne Stuti Maho
Na Cāhvānaṃ Dhyānaṃ Tadapi Ca Na Jāne Stutikathāḥ
Na Jāne Mudrāste Tadapi Ca Na Jāne Vilapanaṃ
Paraṃ Jāne Mātastvad Anusaraṇaṃ Kleśaharaṇam

content.shloka:
Vidheragnaanena Dravinavirahena Aalasatayaa
Vidheyaashkyatvat Tava Charanayoh Yaa Chyuti Rabhoot
Tadethath Kshanthavyam Janani Sakalopaadhikarunaah
Vipadhreva Nityam Tvadeeya Charanau Eva Sharanam
content.meaning: Due to ignorance of rules, due to poverty, due to laziness, due to incapacity, whatever lapses have occurred at Your feet - O Mother, may You forgive all of these, You who are compassionate to all. In times of calamity, Your feet alone are my constant refuge.
content.transliteration:
Vidherāgnānena Draviṇavirheṇa Ālasatayā
Vidheyāśakyatvāt Tava Caraṇayoḥ Yā Cyuti Rabhūt
Tadethat Kṣanthavyaṃ Janani Sakalopādhikaruṇāḥ
Vipadhrevā Nityaṃ Tvadīya Caraṇau Eva Śaraṇam

content.shloka:
Aparaadha Sahasraani Kriyanteharniisham Mayaa
Daaso Yamiti Maam Maatva Kshamasva Parameshvari
content.meaning: Thousands of offenses are committed by me day and night. Considering me as Your servant, please forgive me, O Supreme Goddess.
content.transliteration:
Aparādha Sahasrāṇi Kriyanteharnisam Mayā
Dāso Yamiti Māṃ Mātvā Kṣamasva Parameśvari

content.shloka:
Prithivyaam Putraaste Janani Bahavah Santi Saralah
Param Teshaam Madhye Viralavataro Haam Tava Sutah
Madeeyo Yamaparaadho Yadvaa Ambaa Agareeyo
Tadetath Kshanthavyam Janani Tava Dasyah Sharanaagata
content.meaning: O Mother, You have many dutiful children on this earth. But among them, I am a rare wayward son. Whatever offense of mine, O Mother, however great it may be, please forgive it. Your servant has come to take refuge.
content.transliteration:
Pṛthivyāṃ Putraste Janani Bahavaḥ Santi Saralāḥ
Paraṃ Teṣāṃ Madhye Viralāvatāro Hāṃ Tava Sutaḥ
Madīyo Yāmaparādho Yadvā Ambā Agarīyo
Tadethat Kṣanthavyaṃ Janani Tava Dāsyaḥ Śaraṇāgata

content.shloka:
Kuputo Jaayeta Kvachidapi Kumaataa Na Bhavati
Tasmaattva Maulah Kulajalanidhe Sarvajagataah
Gatiste Me Naanyaa Tvadapi Janani Kshantih Abhayam
Samaalochhya Amba Tvamapi Nitaraam Nohi Paratah
content.meaning: A bad son may sometimes be born, but a bad mother never exists. Therefore, O ocean of the family lineage of the world, I have no other refuge but You. O Mother, considering this, grant me forgiveness and fearlessness; there is no one else beyond You.
content.transliteration:
Kuputo Jāyeta Kvacidapi Kumātā Na Bhavati
Tasmāttvaṃ Maulaḥ Kulajalanidhe Sarvajagatāḥ
Gatiste Me Nānyā Tvadapi Janani Kṣāntiḥ Abhayam
Samālocya Amba Tvamapi Nitarāṃ Nohi Parataḥ

content.shloka:
Aadau Karmaprasangaat Kalayati Kalashan Jaathare Sthitah
Vindhyan Janturvipannoh Jaatharajatharena Pratyaham Jaatabodhah
Taatoojjhaatvaa Namoham Bhavati Bhava Bhavodhbhava Kleshapaatram
Tasmaatpraachyaam Praseeda Prabhu Mama Parahimsaamaamaraadhi Maheshaat
content.meaning: From the beginning, due to the force of past karma, the being suffers in the womb. After birth, distressed by the fire of worldly existence, forgetting You due to delusion, one becomes a vessel of suffering. Therefore, O Lord Mahesha, be gracious to me and protect me from the cycle of worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Ādau Karmaprasangāt Kalayati Kalaśan Jāthare Sthitaḥ
Vindhyan Jantuvipannoḥ Jāthara Jaṭhareṇa Pratyahaṃ Jātabodhaḥ
Tātojjhātvā Namohaṃ Bhavati Bhava Bhavodbhava Kleśapātraṃ
Tasmātprācyāṃ Prasīda Prabhu Mama Parahiṃsāmāmarādhi Maheśāt

content.shloka:
Balyaath Kriidaasakthah Tarunatarayoh Kaamini Vashah
Vriddhastvyaadhi Grastaah Paramithihithah Kenachidapi
Praneta Bhaktih Shraddha Shiva Shiva Shiveti Parivanchanashiva
Tatstaamaatpraachyam Praseeda Bhava Maamevamakhilam
content.meaning: In childhood, absorbed in play; in youth, enslaved by desire; in old age, afflicted by disease - at no time was I able to worship You. Never did devotion arise, never the faith to chant 'Shiva Shiva.' Therefore, O Lord, be gracious to me despite all this.
content.transliteration:
Bālyāt Krīḍāsaktaḥ Taruṇatarayoḥ Kāmini Vaśaḥ
Vṛddhastvyyādhi Grastāḥ Paramithihitaḥ Kenacidapi
Praṇetā Bhaktiḥ Śraddhā Śiva Śiva Śiveti Parivañcanaśiva
Tatstāmātprācyāṃ Prasīda Bhava Māmevamakhilam

content.shloka:
Na Poojayaami Te Devam Na Cha Archayaami Sarvadaa
Na Vandaami Mahaadeva Kshamasva Parameshvara
content.meaning: I have not worshipped You, O Lord, nor have I ever offered You homage. I have not bowed to You, O Mahadeva. Please forgive me, O Supreme Lord.
content.transliteration:
Na Pūjayāmi Te Devaṃ Na Ca Arcayāmi Sarvadā
Na Vandāmi Mahādeva Kṣamasva Parameśvara

content.shloka:
Gaatrampanke Pranamyaasi Jalamapyaacharanaan Manah
Pushhpam Naivopahaaraya Na Dhupam Na Cha Deepakam
Kshamasva Nanu Daivya Sadaashiva Sarvam Aparaadham
content.meaning: My body has not prostrated in mud, nor has my mind drawn water for worship. I have offered no flowers, no incense, no lamp. O divine Sadashiva, please forgive all my offenses.
content.transliteration:
Gātrampanke Praṇamyāsi Jalamapyyācarāṇān Manaḥ
Puṣpaṃ Naivopahārāya Na Dhūpaṃ Na Ca Dīpakam
Kṣamasva Nanu Daivya Sadāśiva Sarvaṃ Aparādham

content.shloka:
Aavaahanaath Na Jaanaami Visarjanaath Na Jaanaami
Poojaam Chaiva Na Jaanaami Kshamyataam Parameshvara
Mantra Heenam Kriyaa Heenam Bhakti Heenam Maheshvara
Yatpoojitam Mayaa Deva Paripoornam Tadastu Me
content.meaning: I know not how to invoke You, nor how to bid You farewell. I know not how to worship You properly. Forgive me, O Supreme Lord. My worship has been devoid of mantras, devoid of rituals, devoid of devotion. O Mahadeva, whatever worship I have offered, may You accept it as complete.
content.transliteration:
Āvāhanāt Na Jānāmi Visarjanāt Na Jānāmi
Pūjāṃ Caiva Na Jānāmi Kṣamyatāṃ Parameśvara
Mantra Hīnaṃ Kriyā Hīnaṃ Bhakti Hīnaṃ Maheśvara
Yatpūjitaṃ Mayā Deva Paripūrṇaṃ Tadastu Me
